lessons.title: to be: am, is, are
lessons.subtitle: I am, you are, he/she/it is · Olumsuz ve soru

rules.title: I am, you are, he/she/it is
rules.text: I am (I'm), you/we/they are (you're), he/she/it is (he's).

rules.title: Olumsuz ve soru
rules.text: Olumsuz: is not (isn't), are not (aren't). Soru: Is he…? Are you…?

lessons.title: Present Simple
lessons.subtitle: he / she / it + -s · don't / doesn't

rules.title: he / she / it + -s
rules.text: I work, you work, ama he works, she lives, it rains. -o, -sh, -ch → -es: goes, watches.

examples.t: My father watches the news every evening.

rules.title: don't / doesn't
rules.text: Olumsuz: I don't like…, he doesn't like… (doesn't'tan sonra -s yok).

drills.tr: Erkek kardeşim her pazar futbol oynar.

drills.s: We ___ watch TV in the morning.

lessons.title: Do / Does ile soru
lessons.subtitle: Do you…? / Does he…? · Soru kelimeleri
lessons.intro: Present Simple'da soru do / does ile kurulur.

rules.title: Do you…? / Does he…?
rules.text: Do I/you/we/they…? Does he/she/it…? (fiil yalın kalır)

rules.title: Soru kelimeleri
rules.text: What, where, when, how often + do/does: Where do you work?

examples.t: How often does he call you?

lessons.title: Düzenli fiiller: -ed

rules.text: work → worked, play → played, live → lived, study → studied.

rules.title: didn't + yalın fiil
rules.text: Olumsuz: I didn't work. Soru: Did you work?

drills.s: They ___ in Paris for two years.
We ___ go out because it was raining.

unit.title: Günlük diyaloglar
unit.subtitle: Emma ve Jack ile gerçek konuşmalar · 4 ders

lessons.title: Tanışma
lessons.subtitle: Hi! I'm Emma. Nice to meet you.
lessons.intro: Emma ve Jack ilk kez tanışıyor.

lines.t: Hi! I'm Emma. Nice to meet you.
lines.tr: Selam! Ben Emma. Tanıştığıma memnun oldum.

lines.t: Hi Emma, I'm Jack. Nice to meet you too.
lines.tr: Selam Emma, ben Jack. Ben de memnun oldum.

lines.t: Where are you from, Jack?
I'm from Manchester. And you?
I'm from Dublin, but I live in London now.
Cool! What do you do?
I'm a nurse. What about you?
I work in IT. Shall we grab a coffee sometime?
lines.tr: Bilişimde çalışıyorum. Bir ara kahve içelim mi?

lessons.title: Kafede
lessons.subtitle: Hi there! What can I get you?

lines.t: Hi there! What can I get you?
Could I have a cappuccino, please?
Sure. Small or large?
Large, please. And a blueberry muffin.
lines.tr: Büyük lütfen. Bir de yaban mersinli kek.

lines.t: Is that to have here or to take away?
To have here, thanks.
That's six pounds fifty.
Here you are. Can I pay by card?

lessons.title: Yol sormak
lessons.subtitle: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

lines.t: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
Go straight on and take the second left.
lines.tr: Düz gidin ve ikinci soldan dönün.

lines.t: Is it far from here?
No, it's about ten minutes on foot.
Is there a bus?
Yes, the number 12 stops right there.
Thanks a lot!
No problem. Have a nice day!

lessons.title: Hafta sonu planı
lessons.subtitle: What are you doing this Saturday?

lines.t: What are you doing this Saturday?
Nothing special. Why?
Do you fancy going to the cinema?
Sounds great! What's on?
There's a new comedy. Everyone says it's hilarious.
lines.tr: Yeni bir komedi var. Herkes çok komik diyor.

lines.t: Perfect. What time shall we meet?
How about six outside the cinema?
Deal. See you on Saturday!

examples.t: She asked me if I was ready.
They asked where the station was.

drills.s: "I am busy." → He said he ___ busy.
"We live in Paris." → They said they ___ in Paris.
She ___ me that she was leaving.
"Are you OK?" → She asked me ___ I was OK.

unit.title: Metin okuma ve anlama
unit.subtitle: Kısa metinler, bilmediğin kelimeye dokun · 3 ders

lessons.title: A Day in London
lessons.subtitle: My name is Sophie and I've …

text.t: My name is Sophie and I've lived in London for six years. Every morning I take the Tube to work, which is quick but often crowded. At lunchtime I like to sit in a park with a sandwich, especially when the weather is nice. After work I sometimes meet friends at a pub or go to a museum, because most of them are free. The city is expensive, but there is always something to do. I miss the quiet of my hometown, but London feels like home now.
text.tr: Benim adım Sophie ve altı yıldır Londra'da yaşıyorum. Her sabah işe metroyla giderim; hızlı ama genelde kalabalık. Öğle arasında, özellikle hava güzelken, bir parkta sandviçimle oturmayı severim. İşten sonra bazen bir pubda arkadaşlarla buluşurum ya da bir müzeye giderim, çünkü çoğu ücretsiz. Şehir pahalı ama her zaman yapacak bir şey vardır. Memleketimin sessizliğini özlüyorum ama Londra artık evim gibi.

qs.q: How long has Sophie lived in London?
How does Sophie go to work?
Why does she go to museums?

lessons.title: An Email to a Friend
lessons.subtitle: Hi Sam! How are you? I'm …

text.t: Hi Sam! How are you? I'm doing well. I started university in September and it's great, although the workload is heavy: we have assignments every week. I share a flat with two students from Brazil and Japan. We cook together on Fridays and try each other's traditional dishes. Last weekend we went hiking in the mountains and got completely lost! Why don't you come and visit me in December? Write back soon. Best wishes, Max.
text.tr: Selam Sam! Nasılsın? Ben iyiyim. Eylülde üniversiteye başladım ve harika, gerçi iş yükü ağır: her hafta ödevimiz var. Brezilya'dan ve Japonya'dan iki öğrenciyle bir daireyi paylaşıyorum. Cumaları birlikte yemek yapıyor, birbirimizin geleneksel yemeklerini deniyoruz. Geçen hafta sonu dağlarda yürüyüşe çıktık ve tamamen kaybolduk! Aralıkta beni ziyarete gelsene? Yakında yaz. Sevgiler, Max.

lessons.title: Tea Time
lessons.subtitle: The British drink about one hundred …

text.t: The British drink about one hundred million cups of tea every day. Most people drink it with milk, and some add sugar. Tea is not just a drink: it is a way to relax, to welcome guests or to take a break at work. In the past, rich families had "afternoon tea" with small sandwiches, scones and cakes. Today this tradition is popular in hotels and cafés, especially with tourists. If someone offers you "a cuppa", they are inviting you for a cup of tea.
text.tr: İngilizler her gün yaklaşık yüz milyon fincan çay içer. Çoğu kişi sütlü içer, bazıları şeker de ekler. Çay sadece bir içecek değildir: rahatlamanın, misafirleri ağırlamanın ya da işte mola vermenin bir yoludur. Geçmişte zengin aileler küçük sandviçler, skonlar ve keklerle "ikindi çayı" yapardı. Bugün bu gelenek otellerde ve kafelerde, özellikle turistler arasında popülerdir. Biri size "a cuppa" önerirse sizi bir fincan çaya davet ediyordur.

qs.q: How do most British people drink tea?
What did rich families eat at afternoon tea?

unit.title: Serbest konuşma
unit.subtitle: Fikir söyle, derdini anlat, kendini tanıt · 3 ders

lessons.title: Fikrini söyle
lessons.subtitle: Jack, do you think it's better to live in the city or in the countryside?
lessons.intro: Şehir mi köy mü? Jack fikrini savunuyor.

lines.t: Jack, do you think it's better to live in the city or in the countryside?
lines.tr: Jack, sence şehirde mi yaşamak daha iyi, kırsalda mı?

lines.t: In my opinion, the city. There are more jobs and opportunities.
lines.tr: Bence şehir. Daha çok iş ve fırsat var.

lines.t: But cities are noisy and the air is polluted.
lines.tr: Ama şehirler gürültülü ve hava kirli.

lines.t: That's true, but you can go to concerts and museums.
lines.tr: Doğru, ama konserlere ve müzelere gidebilirsin.

lines.t: I dream of a little cottage by a lake.
lines.tr: Ben göl kenarında küçük bir kulübe hayal ediyorum.

lines.t: It sounds lovely, but I'd get bored there.
lines.tr: Kulağa hoş geliyor ama ben orada sıkılırdım.

lines.t: Well, everyone has different tastes!
Exactly. What matters is being happy where you live.
lines.tr: Aynen. Önemli olan yaşadığın yerde mutlu olmak.

lessons.title: Doktorda
lessons.subtitle: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?

lines.t: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
I've had a sore throat and a headache for three days.
lines.tr: Üç gündür boğazım ve başım ağrıyor.

lines.t: Have you got a temperature?
Yes, it was thirty-eight last night.
Let me have a look. Yes, your throat is quite red.
lines.tr: Bir bakayım. Evet, boğazınız epey kızarmış.

lines.t: Is it anything serious?
No, it's just a cold. Drink plenty of fluids and get some rest.
lines.tr: Hayır, sadece soğuk algınlığı. Bol sıvı için ve dinlenin.

lines.t: Thank you, doctor. Should I stay off work?

lessons.title: İş görüşmesi
lessons.subtitle: Could you tell me a little about yourself?

lines.t: Could you tell me a little about yourself?
Sure. I'm an engineer and I've worked for a construction company for five years.
lines.tr: Tabii. Mühendisim ve beş yıldır bir inşaat şirketinde çalışıyorum.

lines.t: Why do you want to work for us?
Your company works on exciting projects and I'd like to grow professionally.
lines.tr: Şirketiniz heyecan verici projelerde çalışıyor ve mesleki olarak gelişmek istiyorum.

lines.t: What are your main strengths?
I'm reliable, I work well in a team and I learn quickly.
lines.tr: Güvenilirim, ekipte iyi çalışırım ve hızlı öğrenirim.

lines.t: When would you be able to start?
In two weeks, once I've finished my current project.
lines.tr: İki hafta sonra, mevcut projemi bitirince.
